narr: Weak flow aloft and high PWATs (1.77 at PIT), which was just below daily records but in the upper 1-2% of observations at this time of year, created the ideal environment for flash flooding to occur in isolated regions of western PA.
ev: Multiple areas experienced flooded due to back building storm. Richey Run broke from its banks and flooded Route 208, Route 338 was closed between Ritts Station Road to Blairs Corners Road, and roadways near the county line was affected.
